# Changelog

All notable changes to Lantern are documented here.

Based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/).
License: MIT. Maintainer: Lantern contributors.

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- A streaming export API.
- A command-line preview.

## [2.1.0] - 2026-10-14

### Changed

- Preserve the order of imported records.

### Deprecated

- The legacy configuration key.

### Removed

- The obsolete compatibility mode.

### Fixed

- Handle Unicode paths.

### Security

- Reject oversized network frames.

## [2.0.0] - 2026-09-01 [YANKED]

### Added

- Initial public API.
